text: The Senior Cultural Affairs Officer, Economic Development and Culture Division will give a presentation on the Outcomes from the Previous Term - 2019-2022.

The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager of Economic Development and Culture and Senior Cultural Affairs Officer, Economic Development and Culture, to develop a committee work plan based on the comments and suggestions made during discussion on this Item, and report back to the next meeting of the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee.
